notes.title: ver1.0.7 bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed a bug related to door behavior

notes.title: ver1.0.6 implementation of timer display switching
notes.content: It is now possible to switch the timer display from "Others" in the settings.

notes.title: ver1.0.5　Implementation of clear time
notes.content:
You can now see the time elapsed during the game.
When selecting a difficulty level, the fastest clear time is now displayed.

notes.title: Ver1.0.4 Some corrections
notes.content:
Fixed some minor bugs
Some fixes to the tutorial
Improved reticle visibility

notes.title: ver1.0.3 Some fixes
notes.content:
Adjustment of difficulty level
Item slots changed so that they are always displayed
Adjustment of item generation balance

notes.title: ver1.0.2　Adjustment of difficulty level
notes.content:
The speed of the mummies now varies with the level of difficulty.
The long press time required to trigger a flash has been reduced.

notes.title: ver1.0.1 Fixed a minor bug.
notes.content:
Fixed a bug that prevented achievements from opening properly.
Fixed a bug that caused some objects to get stuck.
